landwasserviadukt.name: Landwasser Viaduct
landwasserviadukt.slogan: A curved stone arch the train vanishes through into the cliff.
landwasserviadukt.line: Built in 1901-02 to 65 m high, it went up without scaffolding, using two cranes instead.

muestair.name: Müstair Convent
muestair.slogan: Walls still painted by hands from Charlemagne's age.
muestair.line: Founded around 775, its church holds Carolingian frescoes painted about 800, still in place.

churkathedrale.name: Chur Cathedral
churkathedrale.slogan: Eight centuries of stone above the old bishop's town.
churkathedrale.line: Its choir was consecrated in 1178, and its late-Gothic high altar was finished in 1492 by Jakob Russ.

stmoritzschieferturm.name: Leaning Tower of St. Moritz
stmoritzschieferturm.slogan: The old church is gone; its tilting tower still holds the hill.
stmoritzschieferturm.line: Standing 33 m tall and leaning about 5.5 degrees, it is all that remains of the old St. Mauritius church.

tarasp.name: Tarasp Castle
tarasp.slogan: A white fortress on a rock above the Lower Engadine.
tarasp.line: Dresden industrialist Karl August Lingner bought it in 1900 and restored it, but died in 1916 without ever living there.
